summary: The task presents one coherent payment-batch restart incident with durable-state, accounting, publication and close invariants that interact across COBOL, shell and SQLite. The supplied contracts make the problem fair without turning the instruction into a bug checklist.

evidence.observation: Incident-first two-paragraph handoff identifies restart duplication, stale publication and the durable database as restart authority.
Operational notes define replay identity, internal/external resume semantics and capacity rules.
Finance/close notes couple financial effects, ledger completeness, publication and completion prerequisites.
Twelve requirement groups are exercised across 37 behavioral cases rather than isolated one-file assertions.
Oracle passed 37/37 and NOP retained 7 P2P while failing all 30 F2P, supporting solvability and meaningful starter failure.

change_scope: Fresh semantic review under protocol 2.1 / packet-result schema v3; solver-visible task content unchanged.
do_not_change: Do not weaken behavioral verifier coverage or exactly-once/restart invariants merely to improve agent pass rate.

PLAUSIBLE_PARTIAL_FIXES: Fix replay identity only, leaving resume routing able to repeat durable effects.
Prevent duplicate reservation rows only, while capacity, clearing or ledger reconstruction remains inconsistent.
Balance ledger totals only, while missing route-specific obligations or cross-cycle scope still permits a false balance.
Gate authorization only, while stale response/clearing publication can still escape a held retry.
